releases.displayName: Deluxe Edition Update: Commentary & Storyboard Modes

notes.title: Deluxe Edition DLC owners now get two new behind-the-scenes playable game modes.

items.text: Commentary Mode*
Play Dispatch with 16+ hours of behind-the-scenes insights with commentary tracks.
Find this mode in your Settings menu and select either Cast or Crew.
Commentary changes dynamically according to the key gameplay choices you make.
Full breakdown of featured cast and crew members can be found here.: Storyboard Mode
Play Dispatch in the original storyboard animatics.
Find this mode in your Settings menu to toggle on or off.

Can be toggled mid-scene.: You can play Storyboards with Commentary off, or play them both at the same time.: *Commentary audio is available in English only with no subtitles, but the base game’s dialogue still shows subtitles in your selected language while the Commentary plays. Storyboard Mode uses the original game dialogue in all available subtitled languages.

New Optional Censorship Settings
Added optional visual censorship filters, accessible in Game Menu > General Settings > Filters.
Uncensored remains the default on Steam.
New Coverage Settings, if you choose to toggle censorship to "On".
Toggling this setting on will provide you the following Style Settings:
Mosaic: a demure pixelated blob
Chaotic: covers up with whatever's lying around, like jorts
Blackout: This standard censorship style is still available for maximum coverage.
